The problem

AI acts first. Humans find out later.

Every day, AI tools paste credentials, exfiltrate API keys, and send sensitive data to external servers. By the time you notice, it's already been sent. Kasbah stops it at the source — like a fortress wall stops invaders before they breach the gate.

How it works

Four steps. Thirty seconds.

1
DetectKasbah sees what the AI is attempting — paste, upload, API call, command execution. Five verbs intercepted at the gate.
2
Bind"Who is in charge of this session?" You are. Authority is claimed locally on your device via HMAC-signed tickets.
3
EnforceEvery action checked against your delegation. Secrets detected, risk scored 0-100, unauthorized actions blocked at the wall.
4
ReclaimOne click freezes all agentic processes. Authority reclaimed. Hash-chained audit trail preserved. The fortress holds.
